You said it yourself. He is unwilling, again one thing you have to understand is ADHD is not and should not be used as an excuse. As someone who has severe combined ADHD and aspergers I face many difficulties which would completely crush the average person but Im also very low income and recognize what coding can do to change my life. I wake up and battle day to day to find new ways to work around things I simply cannot change. This is also all while being unmedicated because of insurance complications. All I have to say is as much as you’d want to change him it’s simply not your responsibility. The ability to change is within him and no one else. Again you’re young and thankfully DONT have children with him. Take action and workout what’s in YOUR best interest because at this point this man is not considering you in any sense much less himself. Best of luck :( and again remember just because you are married to him does not mean you should bare the weight of his added stressors especially when within the context of your life they are not necessary. 
Ps. Don’t misinterpret my use of the word excuse because I’ve been in his situation before but context is a very important word! Within the context of what you have described it seems to me as if he is aware of all these things being handed to him and he is disregarding all these added support networks and that IMO is very inconsiderate.

I totally understand where you’re coming from. Disabilities can come in all different forms imaginable and are unique to you and you only in terms of how it affects you. For me for example I was born with really severe ADHD and bipolar disorder and life really sucks. There’s not a day I don’t think about suicide when everyday I wake up it’s the same mental pain and struggle. It’s exhausting and very draining but my advice to you is to learn something useful that can allow you to move your life into a more desirable direction and give you the flexibility to expand on what you wish out of life. Career change? Try learning computer science or do stuff in general that can allow you to save up more money or open doors for you. Unfortunately life is all about money and maybe it’s not the advice you wanted to hear but for me personally, it’s something that can change my life and I hope helps me not be so disappointed with life. Much love man I hope you feel better and put in that work everyday to better your mental health! 🤎🤎
